{{Quote|Since you have all been such lovely captives, I think I shall let you all go free. No, on second thoughts, I have changed my mind. You all must die. Sorry.|Kird Telak|<ref name="RII" />}}
'''Kird Telak''' was a [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] and leader of [[Telak's Terrors]]. He was a former [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Scout/Legends|scout]] for six years until he grew bored of the profession, and so turned to piracy.
